gaps: Which listing tool and what it returns (mandates vs. standing instructions vs. cheques/auto-debits) is unspecified; the description says 'cancel' but the policy only names cancel_mandate and stop_cheque_payment, so the exact object type is ambiguous

What 'wrong-id correction' means: whether the assistant or customer initially picked the wrong ID, whether a cancellation already happened, and how to remediate (cancellation may be irreversible, so whether re-creating is possible or the assistant must only avoid the wrong cancel)
How payee matching works: exact vs. fuzzy name match, case/spelling variants, and what to do with multiple mandates for the same payee, no matches, or similar payee names
Whether and how to confirm with the customer before cancelling (policy requires confirmation but not the format, or whether to present the matched ID/amount/frequency for verification)
Whether to re-list after cancellation is mandatory and how to report the result (verify the target is gone/status cancelled and the other mandates untouched)
Customer behavior: may give ambiguous payee, change their mind, supply an ID not linked to them (refuse), or dispute which one to cancel
Handling of tool errors, already-cancelled or inactive mandates, and filtering of statuses in the list
Conventions on what details to show customers (hiding internal IDs/field names vs. needing to reference the ID) given the plain-language communication rule
Whether escalation or a service request applies if cancellation fails or an incorrect cancel cannot be undone
